corrections_to_slate.claim: DreamOn's advertised mask_expansion/delete_eos_token kwargs are inert, so its headline length-elasticity was never exercised
corrections_to_slate.verdict: the mechanical fact is TRUE; the inference is REFUTED; the word 'advertised' is FALSE
corrections_to_slate.evidence: (1) both names appear 0 times in DreamOn generation_utils.py (sha256 9ef97ad61d77cfbe...); cfg.update(**both) returns them as unused and hasattr stays False. (2) BUT expansion is token-driven, not flag-gated: sampler tests x[0]==expand_token_id and ==delete_token_id, there is no 'if generation_config.mask_expansion' anywhere; config.json ships expand_token_id 151667 and mask_token_id 151666, and expand_budget=None becomes max_gen_len*2. (3) Our own telemetry proves it ran: dreamon_fim changed the output length on 871/1033 = 84.3% of tasks (803 longer, 68 shorter) from a constant 4 initial masks. (4) DreamOn's README Parameters section never documents either kwarg.
corrections_to_slate.consequence: Claim (b) is DEAD as a finding about DreamOn. It must NOT be published as a functional defect in a public model. What remains is an internal lab-notebook correction: OUR harness passed two no-op kwargs, and any of our wording claiming 'with mask_expansion=True' must be retracted (DLLM_RESULTS_20260807.md already does).

corrections_to_slate.claim: DreamOn ships no matched-lineage AR native-FIM control on its own evaluation surface, and the missing control reverses the conclusion
corrections_to_slate.verdict: FALSE -- the control exists in the camera-ready
corrections_to_slate.evidence: DreamOn Table 1 (ICLR 2026 camera-ready, verified via OpenReview venueid=ICLR.cc/2026/Conference; arXiv:2602.01326v1 PDF read directly) reports Qwen2.5-Coder-7B single-line 92.6 vs DreamCoder-7B+DreamOn 92.1. AR is already ahead on single-line in the AUTHORS' OWN numbers; they claim to surpass AR only on multi-line (63.8 vs 58.7). Our repo note TASK_SURFACE_LIT_GAPS.md had already recorded this, including the 92.6.

corrections_to_slate.claim: Qwen2.5-Coder-7B is a true matched lineage for Dream-Coder-v0-Base-7B, differing only in mask_token_id
corrections_to_slate.verdict: architectural facts TRUE, but the WRONG MODEL was run
corrections_to_slate.evidence: _run_infilling_5arm_8gpu.sh maps dream_fim|dream_prefix -> models/Dream-Coder-v0-Instruct-7B. So an INSTRUCT diffusion model was compared against a BASE AR model; post-training differs across arms. The six architectural fields are indeed identical across Qwen2.5-Coder-7B / Dream-Coder-Base / Dream-Coder-Instruct / DreamOn (hidden 3584, 28 layers, 28 heads, 4 KV heads, intermediate 18944, vocab 152064, rope_theta 1e6), verified from config.json on disk. Dream-Coder-v0-Base-7B IS on disk, so this is repairable.

corrections_to_slate.claim: suffix-visibility gain +.2314 AR vs +.2991 diffusion -- comparable
corrections_to_slate.verdict: values EXACT; the word 'comparable' overstates it
corrections_to_slate.evidence: difference of gains = +0.0678, paired bootstrap 95% CI [+0.0407, +0.0949], EXCLUDES zero. Diffusion's suffix gain is reliably ~6.8pp larger. Also dream_prefix retains an ORACLE length while qwen_prefix does not, so the two gains are not measured under matched conditions.

corrections_to_slate.claim: (implicit) these numbers are comparable to published infilling results
corrections_to_slate.verdict: FALSE -- neither arm reproduces the published value
corrections_to_slate.evidence: published single-line pass@1: DreamCoder+DreamOn 92.1, Qwen2.5-Coder-7B 92.6. Ours: 70.18 and 76.38 -- gaps of -21.9pp and -16.2pp. Dominant identified cause is the plus-axis ceiling of 0.8025: after restricting to gold-feasible items ours become 86.25 and 93.24, i.e. close to published. Reassuring about the harness, damning for the raw headline.

robust_findings_that_survive: Suffix visibility is worth +0.2314 (AR) and +0.2991 (diffusion), both p<1e-56; bidirectional context is an affordance of the FIM task FRAMING, available to AR, not a property of the model class. This is the most defensible result in the pilot.
AR beats the two non-oracle-equivalent diffusion arms by 5-6pp (p<=1.9e-09), and this survives ceiling restriction (p<=3.7e-06).
The oracle length handout is worth +5.7pp to DreamOn (p=4.1e-14), so which diffusion configuration is the comparator decides whether AR 'wins'.
Zero generation errors and a passing grader self-test in all six arms; merge asserted 8/8 shards and no duplicate ids.

subclaim_S4_inherited_from_A05.why_here: A05 died 2026-08-12 by its own K1 gate; its closeout left this finding ownerless and SUGGESTED A01. That suggestion was examined and REJECTED: A01 is a null-calibration protocol (input-blind nulls / best-constant floors / permutation tests) and this finding contains no null. It is a baseline-configuration + harness-validity result on the SAME model family, repo and run tree B10 already owns, and is the full-program counterpart of B10's own infilling audit.
subclaim_S4_inherited_from_A05.why_not_a_new_proposal: after measurement the evidence base is one integer on one model on two benchmarks plus a one-driver post-processing bug with NIL blast radius whose effect at the published operating point is 1 item. No live hypothesis remains for a standalone kill gate to fail.
subclaim_S4_inherited_from_A05.statement: On full-program code generation, DreamOn-v0-7B's reported weakness is substantially an artefact of one sampler-config integer: initial_masks 8->32 (all else frozen) moves MBPP+ .0899->.3545 (+26.5 pp) and HE+ .1280->.2561. The MBPP+ leg runs on a code path with NO stitch, so it is uncontaminated by the HE+ post-processing defect.
subclaim_S4_inherited_from_A05.must_not_claim_1: NOT 'two independent artefacts each larger than typical method deltas'. The stitch defect's severity is CREATED by fixing the canvas: +0.61 pp at canvas=8, +4.27 pp at 32, +31.10 pp at 128. At the published operating point (initial_masks=8) only 1 of 164 raw outputs is multi-line, so the double-indent corrupts almost nothing and costs exactly 1 item (HumanEval/13). It is an INTERACTION, not a second standalone 31 pp defect.
subclaim_S4_inherited_from_A05.must_not_claim_2: NOT 'published numbers across the repo are affected, including the AR control'. Measured NIL blast radius: 17 arms re-graded, 2 move (both already-known DreamOn HE+ arms, +0.61 pp). All others have exactly 0 items on the buggy branch. There is no shared stitch, hence no diffusion-vs-AR asymmetry to claim.
